scripts.name: Run Quick CI
scripts.command: MISE_ACTIVATE_AGGRESSIVE=1 mise exec node@24.13.1 -- node -e "for(const args of [[require('node:path').join(process.env.T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT,'scripts','prepare-dependencies.ts'),'--for-ci'],['scripts/lastcode-local-ci.ts','--quick']]){const r=require('node:child_process').spawnSync(process.execPath,args,{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.error)console.error(r.error.message);if(r.status===0)continue;process.exit(r.status??1);}"

scripts.name: Build Local Package
scripts.command: MISE_ACTIVATE_AGGRESSIVE=1 mise exec node@24.13.1 -- node "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/lastcode-build-local-package.ts" run

scripts.name: Build Intel package (macOS)
scripts.command: MISE_ACTIVATE_AGGRESSIVE=1 mise exec node@24.13.1 -- node scripts/lastcode-build-intel-package.ts run
